argument: The second witness must change the actual compound path: the first mouth contracts, the remote mouth expands, and a third port shears. A readout, highlight, or connector cannot substitute for changed topology.

With labels, readout, controls, captions, and furniture hidden, the first field should read as one asymmetrical knot with one central absence, not a port diagram, card wall, sheet, ribbon, or folded object. After a pair, the three altered mouths must be findable in the silhouette.

One witness only arms and must not write. A same-port second touch is refused. A distinct second touch, the splice control, Enter, or Space commits the same deterministic relation; Delete restores the exact preceding knot and R releases memory.

The little-critters mechanism is translated from local attention and reciprocal looking into a two-place topological relation. No animal, eye, character, or head-turning image may carry the encounter.

Delete v024 if the first touch commits, if same-port contact commits, if the remote change is cosmetic, if later pairs ignore prior topology, if the blind field reads as seven controls, or if the caption is needed to understand why a second place matters.
